loadRules.roofJointRule: At each issued X/Y grid location take the highest issued joint; use adjacent joints on each Y line as strip bearings.
loadRules.loadSharing: One-way strip resultant to its two bounding roof joints by integrating linear distance weights. Preserve force and first moment. This is an issued lumped deck model, not a plate/shell analysis.

areaBasis.W: actual surface, pressure in the upward local normal

horizontalAction.placement: Equally over roof joints at the largest issued Z.

loadRules.memberGravity: Uniform explicit global -Z line load rho*A*g/1000 on beams/columns; half rho*A*L*g/1000 nodal loads at each axial-bar end. Automatic self_weight stays false.

liveRevision.scope: Only Q is redistributed; preserve original D/W zones, properties and gravity.

assumptions: Linear elastic, small-displacement Euler-Bernoulli bending; shear deformation is omitted.
EB and Timoshenko displacements can differ physically; request tolerances are not adjusted.
No mass is added by observation/load subdivision; this solver performs static analysis only.
Commercial-engine comparisons are diagnostic, not same-engine native truth.
